ticker: Global fashion brands shift to India
US bank failure closes United Fidelity

articles.headline: India Expands Bottled Water Crackdown Over Bacteria Found
articles.brief: Authorities in India have widened their bottled-water crackdown after fresh testing of Bisleri samples detected bacterial contamination, raising significant public health and regulatory concerns across the domestic beverage manufacturing sector.

articles.headline: Volkswagen Pulls Rivals Into Massive India Tax Fight
articles.brief: Volkswagen has reportedly drawn rival German automakers Mercedes-Benz and BMW into an escalating 1.2 billion dollar tax dispute in India, complicating the regulatory landscape for luxury automotive giants operating within the South Asian market.

articles.headline: Global Fashion Brands Shift Orders to India From Bangladesh
articles.brief: Amid ongoing unrest in Bangladesh, international fashion and apparel brands are actively reallocating their manufacturing orders to India, seeking supply chain stability and consistent output across the subcontinent.

articles.headline: Software Giant SAP Weighs Major Job Cuts Amid AI Shift
articles.brief: European software leader SAP is reportedly considering substantial workforce reductions as artificial intelligence rapidly transforms the tech sector, forcing traditional enterprise software giants to restructure their operational models.

articles.headline: Armed Group Boards and Seizes Cargo Ship Off Yemen
articles.brief: Maritime security monitors report that an unidentified armed group has successfully boarded and taken control of a commercial cargo ship off the coast of Yemen, escalating security concerns along vital global shipping lanes.

articles.headline: Chinese Military Tests New Landing Tactics Near Taiwan
articles.brief: The Chinese military has conducted coastal drills practicing specialized amphibious landing tactics targeting Taiwan, keeping regional defense forces on high alert amid persistent geopolitical tensions in the strait.

articles.headline: Nvidia Restricts Advanced Chip Shipments to Four Nations
articles.brief: Following updated U.S. export controls, semiconductor titan Nvidia has ordered manufacturing partners to immediately halt server chip shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia to block unauthorized rerouting to China.

articles.headline: India Pushes Forward With Parliament Expansion and Women Quota
articles.brief: The Indian government is moving to revive legislation expanding parliamentary capacity and implementing a long-awaited 33 percent reservation for women, sparking fierce political debates among national parties regarding electoral boundaries.

articles.headline: United Fidelity Shuts Down in Largest US Bank Failure
articles.brief: U.S. federal regulators have closed Indiana-based United Fidelity Bank after determining the lender could no longer meet its obligations, marking the country's largest commercial bank failure in two years.

articles.headline: Indian Public Sector Banks Post Record Aggregate Net Profit
articles.brief: India's public sector banks have announced a historic milestone, with their combined aggregate net profit surging to an unprecedented 1.09 lakh crore rupees, reflecting strong credit growth and improved asset quality.

articles.headline: Gukesh and Sindarov Battle to Deadlock in Chess Championship
articles.brief: Grandmasters Gukesh and Sindarov remain deadlocked at 1.5-1.5 after three consecutive high-intensity draws in the World Chess Championship matches hosted in Geneva, setting the stage for a tight tactical showdown.

articles.headline: Mohun Bagan and East Bengal Renew Fierce ISL Rivalry
articles.brief: Indian Super League heavyweights Mohun Bagan and East Bengal are set to clash once again in a historic fixture, with East Bengal hunting for its maiden league victory over its crosstown adversaries.

articles.headline: Political Showdown Escalates Over Proposed Delimitation Bill
articles.brief: Indian opposition leaders have criticized upcoming electoral delimitation proposals, accusing the ruling coalition of reshaping the political map for partisan advantage, while allied regional factions navigate shifting stances.

articles.headline: Mumbai Airport Shifts App-Based Cab Pickups to Ease Chaos
articles.brief: Mumbai International Airport has officially relocated Uber and Ola pickup zones to parking reorganisation areas, triggering mixed reactions from travelers grappling with initial confusion, long wait times, and cancellations.

articles.headline: Bombay High Court Orders Return of Property to Senior Citizen
articles.brief: In a landmark ruling protecting elder rights, the Bombay High Court ordered a couple to return a gifted flat to their 88-year-old father after he was forced to live in an old-age home, citing maintenance laws.
